rows.description: Agent spawn utility accepts a `bare: boolean` option and appends `--bare` to the `claude -p` CLI args when `true`, omits it when `false`
rows.verifyMethod: Unit test: mock `child_process.spawn`, assert args include `--bare` when `bare: true` and exclude it when `bare: false`

rows.description: A bare-eligibility classification (map or predicate) exists covering all current Kaya agent types, returning `true` for pure-work agents and `false` for hook-dependent agents, with a safe default of `false` for unknown types
rows.verifyMethod: Unit test: table-driven assertions — `isBarEligible("SkepticalVerifier") === true`, `isBareEligible("ContextLoader") === false`, `isBareEligible("unknown-xyz") === false`

rows.description: The delegation layer automatically consults bare-eligibility before every spawn and passes the flag accordingly — no call site requires manual `bare: true`
rows.verifyMethod: Integration test: spawn one classified-bare and one classified-non-bare agent; confirm correct CLI args in both cases

rows.description: A per-invocation override (`forceBare` / `forceNonBare`) exists and takes precedence over the classification predicate
rows.verifyMethod: Unit test: force-bare on a hook-dependent agent type produces `--bare` in args; force-non-bare on a bare-eligible type omits `--bare`

rows.description: A version gate assertion runs before any bare spawn and throws a clear error if Claude Code < 2.1.81 is detected
rows.verifyMethod: Unit test: mock `claude --version` output to `2.1.80`, assert assertion throws with actionable message; mock `2.1.81`, assert no throw

rows.description: All existing agents that previously relied on hooks continue to spawn without `--bare` and produce identical outputs (no regression)
rows.verifyMethod: Integration/smoke test: run the same task via a hook-dependent agent before and after the change; assert outputs match

rows.description: Documentation exists (README section or `docs/agents.md`) explaining the bare vs. non-bare policy, the classification criteria, tradeoffs (no hooks/LSP/skill walks), and the override mechanism
rows.verifyMethod: `grep -q '\-\-bare' docs/agents.md` succeeds; section headings for "Policy", "Classification", "Tradeoffs", and "Override" are present

rows.description: Bare-spawned agents produce no hook/LSP log output in stderr; non-bare agents continue to emit expected hook lifecycle logs
rows.verifyMethod: Runtime check: capture stderr from one bare and one non-bare spawn; assert hook markers absent in bare stderr, present in non-bare stderr
